title: TOTP / HOTP MFA codes
summary: RFC 4226 HOTP and RFC 6238 TOTP (SHA-1/256/512), base32 secrets, otpauth:// enrollment URIs and constant-time verification with a skew window. Standard library only.

title: SSO login request: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authorization code + PKCE
summary: RFC 7636 PKCE verifier/challenge, state and nonce, authorization URL builder, callback parsing with constant-time state check, and the token request body. Pair with oidc-token-verification to validate the returned ID token.

title: MFA recovery (backup) codes
summary: Unbiased Crockford-style recovery codes, normalization, HMAC-SHA256 hashing for storage and constant-time single-use lookup.

title: Safe calculator and loan / interest math
summary: Expression evaluator without eval (precedence, parentheses, unary minus, %, ^), loan payment, amortization schedule and compound interest rounded to cents.

title: Form schema validation
summary: Declarative server-side form validation (string, email, number, integer, boolean, date; required, length, range, pattern, enum) with stable error codes and unknown-field rejection.

title: SEO files: sitemap.xml, robots.txt with AI-crawler rules, llms.txt
summary: XML-escaped sitemap.xml, robots.txt with optional allow/disallow rules for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot and more) and llms.txt for AI answer engines. Standard library only, byte-exact output.

title: Structured data: JSON-LD and meta / Open Graph tags
summary: JSON-LD script tags escaped so they cannot break out of the element, plus title, description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter card tags with HTML escaping.

title: UTM campaign links: build, parse and strip tracking
summary: Build campaign URLs with utm_* parameters (replacing existing ones, keeping fragments), parse UTM values, and strip tracking parameters (utm_*, gclid, fbclid, msclkid and more) from shared links.

title: OIDC ID token / JWT verification
summary: Verify ID tokens and access-token JWTs with the maintained JOSE library of each language: JWKS keys, algorithm allow-list, issuer, audience, expiry and nonce.

title: SAML 2.0 SSO (service provider)
summary: Validate signed SAML responses and assertions with a maintained SAML library: signature, audience, recipient, time conditions and replay.

title: WebAuthn passkeys
summary: Passkey registration and authentication ceremonies with a maintained WebAuthn server library: challenges, origin/RP ID checks, signature counters.

title: Password hashing (Argon2id / bcrypt / scrypt)
summary: Hash and verify passwords with Argon2id (or bcrypt/scrypt where Argon2 is unavailable), including parameter choice and rehash-on-login.

title: PDF form filling
summary: Fill AcroForm fields in an existing PDF, optionally flatten, and read values back with a maintained, permissively licensed PDF library.

title: PDF parsing and text extraction
summary: Extract page text and metadata from PDFs with a maintained library; notes on scanned PDFs (OCR) and layout limits.

title: Word (DOCX) document editing
summary: Create, edit and read .docx documents (paragraphs, tables, replacing placeholders) with a maintained library.

title: Rich text / HTML sanitization
summary: Sanitize user HTML from rich-text editors with an allow-list sanitizer before storage or rendering.

title: Responsive application shell
summary: React application header, primary navigation, responsive menu disclosure, skip link, and main-content layout.

title: Common API clients
summary: Server-only TypeScript clients for GitHub, Stripe Checkout, Resend, Supabase reads, Microsoft Graph, Google Calendar, OpenAI, Anthropic, Saleor catalog reads, and Steel sessions with explicit credentials and bounded HTTP transport.

title: Searchable sortable data table
summary: Typed React table with client-side search, stable sorting, pagination, empty states, and accessible table controls.

title: Environment configuration
summary: Framework-neutral TypeScript schema for environment variables that validates a caller-supplied record at startup, returns a frozen typed object, reports every problem by key without echoing values, redacts secrets, and renders .env.example

title: Health checks
summary: Framework-neutral Fetch handlers for liveness (/healthz) and readiness (/readyz) with concurrent named checks, per-check timeouts, critical versus degraded results, redacted errors, and no-store JSON.

title: HTTP resilience
summary: Runtime-neutral TypeScript retry with exponential backoff and full jitter, AbortSignal-aware timeouts, an idempotency-safe Fetch retry wrapper that honors Retry-After, and an in-process circuit breaker.

title: Notification preferences
summary: A configurable preference form, validated TypeScript domain model, Fetch API client, and authenticated Request/Response adapter with injected atomic persistence.

title: Rate limit
summary: Runtime-neutral TypeScript rate limiting with token bucket, fixed window, and exact sliding window algorithms over a pluggable atomic store, a bounded in-memory LRU store, and Fetch-standard 429 and RateLimit header helpers.

title: Security headers
summary: Framework-neutral TypeScript builder for HTTP response security headers: validated Content-Security-Policy with per-request nonces and report-only mode, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, and X-Frame-Options, applied

title: Structured logger
summary: Framework-neutral TypeScript JSON-lines logger with levels, child bindings, deterministic key-based redaction, bounded cycle-safe serialization, error cause chains, an injectable sink and clock, and x-request-id correlation for Fetch Reques

title: Semantic theme tokens
summary: Framework-neutral light and dark CSS variables for consistent project branding without changing feature behavior.

title: Validated form with submission handling
summary: Typed React form wrapper with injected validation and submission, accessible error summaries, busy state, and duplicate-submit protection.

title: Webhook verification
summary: Framework-neutral TypeScript verification of inbound webhook HMAC-SHA256 signatures over raw body bytes with Web Crypto: generic hex, GitHub, Stripe, and Standard Webhooks/Svix, with secret rotation, timestamp tolerance, and a size-capped r
